messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['I AM CONTACTING YOU TO ASSIST ME TO RE-PROFILE THE FUNDSANDEQUALLY INVEST SAME ON HIS BEHALF.', 'Webb and Wire customers must click Treasury Management to access Colonial Connection.', 'These instructions are to be e-mailed and followed by all members of the Business and Commercial Treasury Services.', 'Furthermore, I will be most willing to go into partnership with you to see this project completed in earnest.', 'I seek to have business dealings with you and your companies, in capital investments for business dealings.', 'We have unanimously agreed that you will be entitled to 30% of the total sum, while 10%Is set aside to offset expenses incurred during the transaction.', 'The Co-operative Bank United Kingdom Cash Management: Details Confirmation Procedure Dear The Co-operative Bank Corporate customer!', 'The Co-operative Bank Plc Business: Details Confirmation Procedure Dear The Co-operative Bank Commercial user!', 'I HAVE A BUSINESS WHICH WILL BE BENEFICIAL TO BOTH OF US.', 'I would like you to register with our agency as one of our foreign suppliers that supplies relief materials to our organization.', 'It is my desire to contact you on honesty and sincerity to assist me in transferring the sum of $8,500,000(Eight Million Five Hundred Thousand United States Dollars) inherited from my father late Mr. Hassan Ahmed, to your country for investment.', 'Upon completion of this transaction I have decided to give you 30% of the total sum, 60% of the fund which is our share will be used for investment in any foreign country of our choice.', 'I am saddled with problems of my ill-health of protracted diabetes and high blood pressure which is getting of increase in the recent times, more importantly getting a trustworthy individual abroad to receive the sum of US$13.2million on our behalf which I intend to invest in your company.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
